commands.title: Centre Window
commands.description: Moves the window to the middle of the screen, keeping its size unless it does not fit.

commands.title: Maximise Window
commands.description: Fills the screen, leaving the menu bar and Dock visible.

commands.title: Left Half
commands.description: Fills the left half of the screen; run it again to cycle through two thirds and one third.

commands.title: Right Half
commands.description: Fills the right half of the screen; run it again to cycle through two thirds and one third.

commands.title: Top Half
commands.description: Fills the top half of the screen; run it again to cycle through two thirds and one third.

commands.title: Bottom Half
commands.description: Fills the bottom half of the screen; run it again to cycle through two thirds and one third.

commands.title: First Third
commands.description: Fills the first third of the screen: the left column, or the top row on a portrait display.

commands.title: Centre Third
commands.description: Fills the middle third of the screen, as a column or, on a portrait display, a row.

commands.title: Last Third
commands.description: Fills the last third of the screen: the right column, or the bottom row on a portrait display.

commands.title: First Two Thirds
commands.description: Fills the first two thirds of the screen, from the left or, on a portrait display, from the top.

commands.title: Last Two Thirds
commands.description: Fills the last two thirds of the screen, from the right or, on a portrait display, from the bottom.

commands.title: Top Left Quarter
commands.description: Fills the top-left quarter of the screen.

commands.title: Top Right Quarter
commands.description: Fills the top-right quarter of the screen.

commands.title: Bottom Left Quarter
commands.description: Fills the bottom-left quarter of the screen.

commands.title: Bottom Right Quarter
commands.description: Fills the bottom-right quarter of the screen.

commands.title: First Fourth
commands.description: Fills the first of four strips across the screen, from the left or, on a portrait display, the top.

commands.title: Second Fourth
commands.description: Fills the second of four strips across the screen, from the left or, on a portrait display, the top.

commands.title: Third Fourth
commands.description: Fills the third of four strips across the screen, from the left or, on a portrait display, the top.

commands.title: Last Fourth
commands.description: Fills the last of four strips across the screen, at the right or, on a portrait display, the bottom.

commands.title: Top Left Sixth
commands.description: Fills the left cell of the top row when the screen is split into three columns and two rows.

commands.title: Top Centre Sixth
commands.description: Fills the middle cell of the top row when the screen is split into three columns and two rows.

commands.title: Top Right Sixth
commands.description: Fills the right cell of the top row when the screen is split into three columns and two rows.

commands.title: Bottom Left Sixth
commands.description: Fills the left cell of the bottom row when the screen is split into three columns and two rows.

commands.title: Bottom Centre Sixth
commands.description: Fills the middle cell of the bottom row when the screen is split into three columns and two rows.

commands.title: Bottom Right Sixth
commands.description: Fills the right cell of the bottom row when the screen is split into three columns and two rows.

commands.title: Maximise Height
commands.description: Stretches the window to the full height of the screen, keeping its width and horizontal position.

commands.title: Maximise Width
commands.description: Stretches the window to the full width of the screen, keeping its height and vertical position.

commands.title: Reasonable Size
commands.description: Resizes the window to 60% of the screen, at most 1025 × 900 points, and centres it.

commands.title: Move Up
commands.description: Moves the window to the top edge of the screen without changing its width.

commands.title: Move Down
commands.description: Moves the window to the bottom edge of the screen without changing its width.

commands.title: Move Left
commands.description: Moves the window to the left edge of the screen without changing its height.

commands.title: Move Right
commands.description: Moves the window to the right edge of the screen without changing its height.

commands.title: Toggle Full Screen
commands.description: Moves the window into macOS full screen, or back out of it.

commands.title: Previous Display
commands.description: Moves the window to the previous display, counting left to right, keeping its size and relative position.

commands.title: Next Display
commands.description: Moves the window to the next display, counting left to right, keeping its size and relative position.

commands.title: Restore Window
commands.description: Puts the window back where it was before Spinnet last moved it.

commands.title: Resize Window
commands.description: Resizes the window from its top-left corner to the width and height you set, in points or as a percentage of the screen.

commands.title: Move Window
commands.description: Moves the window to the position you set, in points or as a percentage of the screen.
